description: Scan a local folder of Solidity files, resolve entrypoints and imports, and audit the project with kritisi. Uses the single entrypoint when there is one; otherwise audits a bundle of project files. reportPath ending in .md/.markdown writes Markdown, .pdf writes PDF. Read-only unless a report path is provided.

entry.description: Optional entry .sol path relative to the project folder

includeReport.description: Include the full findings JSON in the response (omitted by default to keep context small)

outputPdf.description: Legacy PDF output path; prefer reportPath

path.description: Path to a directory containing .sol files

reportPath.description: Write a report to this path; .pdf, .md, or .markdown selects the format

name: audit_project
title: Audit a Solidity project folder
